verdict.rationale:
Mem0 Platform documents a first-class memory-expiration feature: setting an `expiration_date` causes the memory to stop surfacing in search once it passes, without deleting the underlying data (mem0-docs-11, mem0-docs-19, mem0-docs-37). This directly satisfies the 'expire so stale facts stop surfacing' part of the story, and is described as avoiding manual cleanup jobs.

missing for 10: explicit TTL (relative duration) configuration distinct from absolute expiration_date, and first-party documentation of recency-weighting/decay in retrieval ranking (only a community aside mentions 'recency' as a retrieval factor, not confirmed in docs).
